description: We're an organization dedicated to fostering community and discourse between anyone who loves wisdom. We host weekly discussion meetings, reading groups, guest speakers, and joint-organization events.

name: Undergraduate Research Society
description: Undergraduate Research Society is an on-campus club dedicated to making research more accessible, celebrated, and connected across all disciplines. We provide students with resources, mentorship, and community to help them thrive in their research paths.

name: Undergraduate Science Journal, UConn
description: USJ is an online, peer-reviewed academic journal that will publish independent research conducted by UConn undergraduate students within all STEM disciplines to promote undergraduate research involvement among UConn student body.

name: Undergraduate Student Government
description: The Undergraduate Student Government (USG) -- advocacy for and by students since 1894. USG exists to represent and advocate for UConn Storrs undergraduate students and student groups and enhance the campus community through stewardship of student fees.

name: Undergraduate Student Government - Hartford Campus
description: Elected members of the Hartford Undergraduate Student Government vow to represent the student body. Any fee-paying student is eligible to help plan events for the Undergraduate student body. For general information contact nick.lanza@uconn.edu

name: Undergraduate Student National Dental Association
description: A student organization empowering future dental professionals at UConn through mentorship, outreach, and advocacy to expand opportunities for underrepresented and service-minded students in dentistry. We are affiliated with the national branch of USNDA.

name: Underwater Robotics, UConn
description: UConn Underwater Robotics is an engineering focused club pursuing building an underwater vehicle to compete in the MATE ROV competition. Join our GroupMe! https://groupme.com/join_group/102888840/riylTOD9

name: UNICEF Campus Initiative
description: The United Nations Children's Emergency Fund (UNICEF) is a humanitarian aid organization that provides children around the world with health care, nutrition, education, emergency aid, clean water and vaccinations among other necessities in times of need.

name: United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization
description: UNESCO is a United Nations organization that promotes human rights through an integrated system of research, education, training, information, and documentation. UNESCO student ambassadors share the principles of human rights outlined on the UDHR.

name: University Ballet Company
description: The University Ballet Company is UConn's first ballet company. We welcome dancers of all levels from pre-professional training to no experience. UBC offers an opportunity to perform in both semesters with auditions held at the beginning of each semester.

name: University of Connecticut Libraries
description: The UConn Library offers space for getting work done, books, electronic resources, gadgets to loan, and public programs to help students looking to get some work done, learn, and grow at each UConn campus.

name: USITT UConn Student Chapter
description: The organization’s mission is to provide an academic learning environment for theatrical design and technology at UCONN including, but not limited to: scenic, costume, lighting, sound, and projection design, technical direction, and scenic charge.

name: Venezuelan Student Association
description: VENSA promotes Venezuelan culture and fosters community at UConn through cultural and social events. The organization welcomes students of all backgrounds who are interested in learning about and celebrating Venezuelan heritage!

name: Veterans and Armed Forces Out Reach Association
description: VALOR is a veterans' and military affiliation group enabling law students to network with other veterans.

name: Video Games and Chess Club
description: A fun, welcoming club where students play chess and video games, improve skills, and enjoy friendly competition.

name: Vietnamese Student Association
description: VSA strives to preserve and promote the Vietnamese culture through various events such as charity, cultural shows, trips, and collaboration with other VSAs. We encourage anyone with interest in Vietnamese culture to join!

name: Voices of Equity
description: Voices of Equity seeks to educate, inspire, and empower the next generation of changemakers spotlighting health equity issues through impactful content, storytelling, and actionable community-based initiatives.

name: Volleyball Club, UConn Men's
description: We compete with other club teams on the regional and national levels.

name: Volleyball Club, UConn Women's
description: The Women's Club Volleyball team competes throughout the year playing teams within the region. The team participates in highly competitive tournaments such as national ranking tournaments, regionals, leagues, and nationals.

name: Walk Buddies, UConn
description: Looking to make new friends or have interesting conversations while getting your steps in? At UConn Walk Buddies, you’ll have this opportunity weekly! Students get to walk and talk around UConn in interest-based pairs with occasional, fun challenges.

name: Wellness Community
description: The Wellness Community is a vibrant, engaged community that provides opportunities to explore different ways to strengthen your overall health and well-being, and contribute to the health and well-being of others.

name: Werth Hall Council
description: Werth Hall Council

name: West Hall Council
description: West Hall Council

name: West Indian Student Organization
description: The purpose of the West Indian Student Organization is to encourage and nurture unity among West Indian students by providing relevant info about the West Indian culture in order to promote multiculturalism and to expand awareness of the West Indies.

name: Western Team, The UConn
description: A Western horseback riding team in the IHSA circuit. Riders compete against other colleges in Western Horsemanship and Reining classes to earn points for themselves as well for the team. A fun and exciting team to be a member of, no experience required!

name: WHUS Radio
description: WHUS is UConn's center for multimedia production. WHUS operates a radio station, an audio/video production studio, and a recording studio. Find us at 91.7 FM, online at whus.org, and @WHUSRadio on Instagram.

name: Wildlife Society UConn Chapter, The
description: The Wildlife Society UConn Chapter is a recognized student chapter of The Wildlife Society. We hold weekly meetings featuring presentations by wildlife professionals and researchers,various community service events, and sponsor field trips.

name: Windham After School Programs
description: Windham After School Programs works with students in grades K-8 at four different schools in Willimantic and Windham by tutoring, mentoring, and encouraging students in all different kinds of activities.

name: Windham Hospital Volunteer Services
description: Windham Hospital Volunteers are given the opportunity to learn new skills and gain valuable experience working in a diverse and demanding community healthcare setting. All majors are encouraged to apply.

name: Women & Minorities in Economics
description: The mission of this organization is to foster an inclusive environment for students interested in economics, with a focus on women and other underrepresented minorities.

name: Women in Business
description: Women in Business is an organization that seeks to foster students' growth, both professionally and personally through building impactful and meaningful relationship with one another, and externally.

name: Women In Business, UConn Stamford
description: Established to create a supportive community for UConn Stamford women majoring or interested in business, leadership, and professional development, welcoming women from diverse backgrounds and cultures.

name: Women in Computer Science
description: As an organization, we hope to build a community of women pursuing their studies in technical fields at UConn. We will provide a supportive and encouraging environment for these women through opportunities of educational and professional development.

name: Women in Film & Media
description: Women in Film and Media brings together women across different fields of media to share experiences, foster creativity, and empower one another through discussion, guest speakers, and networking in a supportive, collaborative space.

name: Women in Math, Science, and Engineering Club (WiMSE)
description: This organization aims to create a supportive community for women to share their knowledge and passion for the science, math, and engineering fields!

name: Women in Physics
description: A community of individuals of all genders who study or hold interest in physics and are dedicated to the eradication of the gender & racial bias within STEM/Physics.

name: Women in Psychology
description: We aim to create an inclusive space for students—especially women—passionate about Psychology. Through networking, mentorship, and leadership, we empower members to grow and thrive, while building a lasting legacy through strong, engaged leadership.

name: Women in Sport
description: Pushing for women empowerment within the male dominated sport industry

name: Women Law Students' Association
description: WLSA is an all inclusive organization aiming to promote an environment of academic, professional, and legal equality for all people who identify as women.

name: Women's Center
description: The Women’s Center provides education, advocacy, and support services for the achievement of women’s equity at the University and larger community.

name: Women's Club Basketball
description: The purpose of the Women’s Club Basketball team is to develop a unified team to compete at the highest level of intensity, while maintaining our standards of sportsmanship, preparation, commitment, enthusiasm, and desire for success.

name: Women's Club Flag Football
description: A student run club dedicated to building a supportive and enjoyable environment for women in flag football. We welcome players of all skill levels to enjoy, learn, and grow as this Olympic-bound sport evolves.

name: Women's Finance Association
description: The Women’s Finance Association (WFA) is UConn’s first student-run organization that cultivates female leadership and unparalleled success in the financial industry. The mission of WFA is to elevate the role of women in finance.

name: Women's Timber Team, UConn
description: The UConn Women's Timber Team focuses on helping students to compete in a safe and accurate manner the many events of a timber sports team. It involves traditional logging techniques into timed events such as the underhand chop, log roll, sawing, etc.

name: Woodsmen, UConn
description: The UCONN Woodsman team is one of many collegiate timbersports programs. Trained by professional and semi-professional lumberjacks, the UCONN woodsman team competes in fairs and collegiate meets spread across the Northeast

name: Woodworking Club
description: This is a beginner friendly club where anyone can engage with woodworking!

name: WordPress Users Group
description: The WordPress Users Group meets once a month as a brownbag to share and hear updates about the blogging and content management software, currently focusing on UITS' Aurora package. Not training sessions, these brownbags allow implementers to share info.

name: World Culture Organization - Hartford Campus
description: The mission of this organization is to promote acceptance of all cultures and backgrounds and provide an inviting environment to celebrate diversity on the UConn Hartford campus.

name: WOW- Week of Welcome
description: Husky WOW | We have a jam packed calendar full of events to help you make connections and make your first few days on campus memorable. Join us for signature events throughout the weekend.

name: Wrestling, UConn
description: UConn Wrestling Club is one for students to continue or begin their wrestling career at a collegiate level.

name: Writing Center
description: The Writing Center is a welcoming space where students and tutors collaborate on writing projects. We believe all students are writers, and we invite them to bring in any type of writing at any stage of the writing process.

name: Yoga Club
description: Yoga club meets weekly on Monday evenings to practice Yoga with a focus on deep relaxation and meditation. Yoga is a great way to relax, relieve stress, and improve flexibility.

name: Your Mental Health Matters
description: Your Mental Health Matters raises awareness, educates communities, and reduces stigma around mental health. We recognize that mental health looks different for everyone and create inclusive, safe spaces to learn, share, and support well-being.

name: Yu-gi-oh! Club, UConn
description: A place for Yu-gi-oh! players to meet others, play and discuss all forms of the hit game by Konami. We offer TCG meetups (where you can bring your own or borrow a deck and play against others), Master Duel coaching by more experienced players, and more!!

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority Inc.
description: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated was founded January 16, 1920 and began as an idea conceived by five coeds at Howard University in Washington D.C.

name: Zeta Psi
description: The Theta chapter of the Zeta Psi fraternity of North America resides here at UConn. We exemplify the values and traditions of Zeta Psi and represent them in the best manner possible.
